Generic.Int64.description: Signed 64-bit integer; range bounded by JavaScript's safe-integer ceiling.

Generic.JSON.name: Generic.JSON
Generic.JSON.description: Any valid JSON value: object, array, primitive, or null

Identity.UUID.name: Identity.UUID
Identity.UUID.description: UUID v4 with automatic base62 encoding for client-facing APIs

Temporal.DateTime.name: Temporal.DateTime
Temporal.DateTime.description: ISO8601 datetime string. Epoch wire values keep this scalar and declare x-temporal-format (unix, unix_millis, unix_micros, unix_nanos) on the property; the unit is never guessed from digit count.

Account.name: Account
Account.comment:
An account a person's agents run their turns on (D104): their accounts at
two vendors, and paid keys. A turn picks the same vendor's open accounts,
then its near ones, then the others by rank, a key last; an account a
provider refuses is out until the time it names, thirty minutes when it
names none, and comes back only when a check of its usage made after that
time finds room, rechecked every two minutes until one does. Its tokens
are metered by the hour, and an account with none left counts as out
until the hour rolls over, or until the provider's own figure lapses.

fields.name: poolAvailability
fields.description: open, near its limit, or out; absent on a row that predates the use, which reads as open.

fields.name: poolOutUntil
fields.description: While the member is out, until when, in epoch milliseconds: the earliest time a check may open it; absent while it is open or near.

fields.name: poolOutReason
fields.description: While the member is out, why, as markOut or the check that put it out said; absent while it is open or near.

fields.name: poolCheckedAt
fields.description: When the last check of the member was reported, in epoch milliseconds; absent before the first.

AccountBudgetBuckets.name: AccountBudgetBuckets
AccountBudgetBuckets.comment: A rolling meter's usage, a sixtieth of its period each, keyed by the meter and the bucket's start; a write deletes the ones that left the window.

fields.name: account
fields.description: The Account row the rows are of; deleting it deletes them.

fields.name: bucket
fields.description: <meter>:<start in epoch milliseconds, fifteen digits>.

fields.name: meter
fields.description: The meter.

fields.name: startsAt
fields.description: When the bucket starts.

fields.name: used
fields.description: What the row used in it.

AccountBudgetHolds.name: AccountBudgetHolds
AccountBudgetHolds.comment: What the row, a scope, holds of a meter for each row inside it, keyed by the meter, that row's type and its key.

fields.name: account
fields.description: The Account row the rows are of; deleting it deletes them.

fields.name: hold
fields.description: <meter>:<type>:<key> of the row it holds for.

fields.name: meter
fields.description: The meter.

fields.name: innerType
fields.description: The type of the row it holds for.

fields.name: innerKey
fields.description: Its key.

fields.name: amount
fields.description: What it holds.

AccountBudgetMeters.name: AccountBudgetMeters
AccountBudgetMeters.comment: One row per meter the row has written, keyed by the meter's name: what it has used in its current period, what it has reserved (its own reservation and what it holds for the rows inside it), the limit setLimit gave it, the start of the period its used counts from, its own reservation with the lease token it was made under, the token onExceeded last directed under, the scope that holds its reservation, and the usage a provider last reported, with its limit, when, and until when it holds.

fields.name: account
fields.description: The Account row the rows are of; deleting it deletes them.

fields.name: meter
fields.description: The meter's name.

fields.name: used
fields.description: What the row has used in its current period (everything without reset; 0 for a rolling meter, whose buckets hold its usage).

fields.name: reserved
fields.description: What the row has reserved: its own reservation and what it holds for the rows inside it.

fields.name: limitValue
fields.description: The limit setLimit gave the row; absent for none.

fields.name: periodStart
fields.description: The start of the period used counts from, for a meter with a fixed reset.

fields.name: reservation
fields.description: The row's own reservation, a part of reserved.

fields.name: token
fields.description: The lease token the own reservation was made under.

fields.name: directed
fields.description: The lease token onExceeded's directive was last sent under.

fields.name: scopeType
fields.description: The type of the scope that holds the reservation.

fields.name: scopeKey
fields.description: Its key.

fields.name: observed
fields.description: The usage a provider last reported, with what the row recorded since; absent before an observe.

fields.name: observedLimit
fields.description: The limit the provider reported; absent for none.

fields.name: observedAt
fields.description: When observe recorded it.

fields.name: observedUntil
fields.description: The resetsAt observe was given; absent without one.

AccountDeadline.name: AccountDeadline
AccountDeadline.comment: The deadlines Account's behaviors arm, one message per row, use and deadline, due when it falls due (D103).

fields.name: rowKey
fields.description: The key of the Account row the deadline is armed on.

fields.name: useId
fields.description: The id of the use that armed it: its anchor field, or the behavior's name for a use the table implements.

fields.name: name
fields.description: The deadline's name, the use's own.

fields.name: at
fields.description: When it was armed to fall due, in epoch milliseconds.

fields.name: payload
fields.description: What the use armed it with, which its deadline hook reads.

AccountEvent.name: AccountEvent
AccountEvent.comment: The events Account's behaviors emit about its rows, one message per event, written in the command's transaction, which a behavior worker hands to the project's handler (D104).

fields.name: rowKey
fields.description: The key of the Account row the event is about.

fields.name: useId
fields.description: The id of the use that emitted it: its anchor field, or the behavior's name for a use the table implements.

fields.name: kind
fields.description: The event's kind, as its behavior declares it.

fields.name: at
fields.description: The time of the command that emitted it, in epoch milliseconds.

fields.name: payload
fields.description: What the event says, as its kind's payloadSchema types it.

AccountKind.name: AccountKind
AccountKind.comment: Whether an account is a person's account at a vendor or a paid key.
